title: Matching Heaven
chinese: 善为士者不武，善战者不怒，善胜敌者不与，善用人者为之下，是谓不争之德，是谓用人之力，是谓配天古之极。
pinyin: Shàn wèi shì zhě bù wǔ， shàn zhàn zhě bù nù， shàn shèng dí zhě bù yǔ， shàn yòng rén zhě wèi zhī xià， shì wèi bù zhēng zhī dé， shì wèi yòng rén zhī lì， shì wèi pèi tiān gǔ zhī jí。
english: He who in (Tao’s) wars has skill Tao’s Assumes no martial port; He who fights with most good will To rage makes no resort. He who vanquishes yet still Keeps from his foes apart; He whose hests men most fulfil Yet humbly plies his art.
Thus we say, “He ne’er contends, And therein is his might.” Thus we say, “Men’s wills he bends, That they with him unite.” Thus we say, “Like Heaven’s his ends, No sage of old more bright.”
